source_census.recall: Unmeasured: this records bounded source discovery, not a meeting-calendar census.

publication_boundary: CE reports are officer reports, not council minutes. Lead sentences are Extracted-band. Two independent publication routes exist. promotion_permitted is review-led: true only where a reviewer set relevance_status=REVIEWED_RELEVANT, resolved site_relationship, and supplied a source-verified project name and allowed procurement stage. auto_publishable is classifier-led: a deterministic floor (a lead-type match and a quote of at least 40 characters) over the strict net, whose precision is measured at 0.900 (Wilson 95% CI 0.799-0.953, n=60 seeded random sample, single non-blind labeller) in apps/public-signal/pipeline/data/ce_lead_precision_labels.json. Classifier-led rows carry no reviewed project name or stage and must never be described as reviewed.
precision: 0.900 point, Wilson 95% CI 0.799-0.953, n=60 seeded random sample of the strict net. Single labeller, not blind to the extractor - weaker than the two-labeller blind recall probe and should be re-labelled independently.
recall: 0.667 point, CI 0.582-0.754, from ce_lead_recall_labels.json - 60-row seeded sample of a 951-row broad-net gap queue, two independent blind labellers, 98% agreement. Measured against the 540-lead corpus; the anchors are unchanged but it has not been re-run against this larger corpus. Document recall (what share of published CE reports the harvester finds) remains unmeasured.
